picks.name: Franco Falsini (Various Artists)
picks.source_note: New compilation on Space Echo Records.
picks.bio: Franco Falsini and brother Riccardo's Interactive Test project -- a small creative laboratory born in early-90s Italy where electronic music was treated as a language, not a genre. "The Interactive Test Experience Vol.1" (June 12, 2026) gathers work released under aliases like Open Space, Youth Wave, and Agent Fylfoyt.
picks.why_listen: Atmospheric techno, digital psychedelia and club-focused machine grooves that capture a specific early-90s Italian club/warehouse scene -- deep source material if you like your techno with some archival weight.

picks.name: Tom Carruthers
picks.source_note: On Operation Madness, House of Underground's sublabel (already seeded).
picks.bio: "Waveforms EP" (July 20, 2026) is a four-track 12" -- Formation, Intensity, State Of Mind, Unit 21 -- on Operation Madness, the sublabel of Paris house label House of Underground.
picks.why_listen: Straightforward functional house from a label sublabel worth tracking if you liked House of Underground's Boo Williams-founded catalog.

picks.name: Alessandro Alessandroni
picks.source_note: Already in your library ("Afro Voodoo", "Afro Darkness").
picks.bio: Already in your library. "Rinascimento e Barocco" (Feb 27, 2026) is an 8-track album of previously unreleased early-1980s recordings on Four Flies Vaults, revisiting Renaissance and Baroque idioms through an intimate, chamber-oriented approach.
picks.why_listen: A different side of an artist you already have filed under Afro-disco -- courtly, acoustic, formal. Good source material rather than a direct DJ tool.

picks.name: Piero Umiliani
picks.source_note: Same Italian library/soundtrack lineage as Alessandroni (above), also on a Four Flies imprint.
picks.bio: Legendary Italian library/soundtrack composer (d. 2001). "Fantasy" (July 17, 2026), recorded in 1983 and never released until now, came out on Four Flies on what would have been his 100th birthday -- his last unreleased title intended for his own Telesound library imprint.
picks.why_listen: A genuinely lost chapter surfacing over 40 years later -- rare occasion to hear "new" Umiliani. Great texture/sample source for anyone into library music.
